## Why visit

One of the region’s most useful stops for this particular brief because its local brewery identity is matched by serious cider interest. The converted-shop room, parquet floor and changing board provide a comfortable setting for comparing RedWillow cask with another style or fermentation tradition. The local CAMRA branch’s 2026 cider award describes boxed, draught and bottled choices and cider-focused events, so this is more than a venue that happens to sell a single cider. Combine it with Waters Green Tavern for a compact Macclesfield outing, adding the Park Tavern or Bollington only if time permits.

## Beer

Official site advertises five cask lines alongside keg; CAMRA describes RedWillow cask, including changing and special releases. CAMRA lists RedWillow Feckless and Wreckless as regular cask beers; its Faithless small-batch range and guest releases change.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** Macclesfield & East Cheshire CAMRA Cider/Perry Pub of the Year 2026; branch report documents still boxes, draught and bottled cider. A May 2026 [local CAMRA report](https://eastcheshire.camra.org.uk/2026/05/redwillow-macclesfield-is-branch-cider-pub-of-the-year/) mentions still cider boxes, Hogan’s keg cider and a Ross-on-Wye tasting event. The event does not establish permanently stocked Ross-on-Wye cider.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

CAMRA’s October 2026 entry reports hot dogs; the official page links a current menu.

## Plan the visit

CAMRA records card-only payment. Check any tasting event separately; past cider-and-cheese evenings are not a November booking.

**Getting there:** Central Macclesfield on Park Green, walkable from the railway station.
